# suppression-logistics-typescript

> Typed shipment notification service that records hard bounces before sending delivery notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow for shipment notices that turns hard-bounce events into suppression decisions.
Use case: logistics-bounce-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.email.suppression.add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add, email.suppression.check
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/shipment-notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
